text: Firdaria reads a life as a series of planetary chapters, and each chapter starts under its own lord. So the Sun's decade begins with the Sun still in charge, nothing else in the mix to soften or complicate it. Whatever the whole chapter turns out to be about usually declares itself here. You may find yourself more visible than you planned, handed a role, asked to lead, or simply noticed. Some people mark this stretch with a beginning that has their name on it, a job taken, a piece of work released, a move made in their own interest rather than someone else's. Others feel it inwardly first, as a plain and slightly uncomfortable question about what they would want said about their work. Energy tends to run high, and so does the wish to be taken seriously. The strain here is the gift seen from the other side. With nothing to soften the Sun, self-regard has no counterweight, and it is easy to mistake your own view of a situation for the whole of it, or to spend more heat on being right than on being useful. Pride bruises easily in this stretch. What steadies it is doing the work where people can see it and letting the results speak. Because this run sets the tone for the years after it, what you start now tends to carry a long way. The growth on offer is easy to name and slow to finish: taking up the room you actually occupy, in front of people who can see you do it.

Inside the Sun's long chapter of visibility, a stretch of it falls to Venus, and the temperature changes without the subject changing. You are still stepping forward. Now you step forward attractively. People warm to you in this stretch more readily than the rest of the decade may explain. Support arrives through liking rather than argument: someone puts your name into a room you are not in, a collaboration forms without much effort, an audience finds you good company. Recognition, when it comes, tends to come wrapped in affection. Romance often runs alongside it, and love in this period has a visible quality, being chosen, being admired, being seen beside someone. Creative work goes well too, since Venus governs the finish on a thing and the Sun governs the signature. What goes wrong here goes wrong softly. Charm smooths a room, and smoothing a room can quietly hollow out the Sun's actual business, which is standing for something. You might trim an opinion to keep a room comfortable, or accept the version of visibility that flatters instead of the one that counts. Vanity is the smaller version of the same trap, enjoying the reflection rather than the work. There is little here that has to be survived. Its lesson is that being seen and being cared for are not opposites, and that a position carried gracefully costs the people around you far less than one carried stiffly.

Mercury's turn under the Sun puts words to the chapter's business. While Mercury holds this part of the decade, the project of being seen becomes a project of being explained. The talking parts of your work tend to grow: meetings and interviews, proposals, teaching, the writing that carries your name, the correspondence that decides things. Many people spend this stretch building language around what they are doing, and find that explaining it changes it. Negotiations cluster here as well, and terms you argue for now often shape the years that follow. Learning has a place in this run too. A skill picked up now tends to serve the whole decade, because it attaches to your name instead of staying a private hobby. Your mind runs busier than usual and probably more restless. Mercury's usual trouble arrives sharpened by the Sun's exposure: cleverness can stand in for substance, and a well-turned account of yourself can start doing the job your actual work should be doing. There is also more paperwork than anyone wants. Honest words are the whole of the discipline here, and they end the stretch with you able to say plainly who you are and what you do, without a performance, to whoever needs to hear it.

When the Moon takes the sub inside the Sun's chapter, daily life pushes its way into a decade otherwise concerned with role and standing. The two lights work differently. The Sun holds one position; the Moon changes nightly, and this run tends to make the chapter's business rise and fall rather than climb. Your visibility comes in waves, moods carry more weight in your decisions than you would like, and confidence that felt settled a month ago may need rebuilding. That is the tempo of the stretch, not a sign that something has gone wrong. Home usually asks for something here. A move, a change in the household, someone in the family who needs you, or simply the discovery that your public life has been running on a private one nobody maintained. Care enters the story in both directions: who feeds you, whom you feed, and whether the position you are growing into leaves room for either. A wider audience may also find you now, since this light has always been associated with the public at large rather than with the powerful few, and work made for large numbers tends to go well. Exposure with no shelter behind it wears on you. Being looked at is tiring when your inner weather is already loud, and a low week can start to look like evidence about your worth. Rest does real work in this period. A life that is livable as well as visible is the only kind that will carry you through the years still to come.

The Sun's decade gets its examination in the stretch Saturn runs. The chapter asks you to stand forward; Saturn asks what the standing rests on, and asks it in the least sentimental terms available. Progress slows in this stretch. Recognition may be delayed, withheld, or handed over in a smaller portion than the effort deserved, and the work in front of you tends to be the unglamorous part, the maintenance, the obligation, the long middle of something you began with more enthusiasm. People in authority feature strongly. You may be answering to someone demanding, carrying responsibility you did not ask for, or learning how much of a position turns out to be administration rather than glory. Criticism lands harder here because the Sun has raised the stakes of being seen. A cold review in this run is information about the work, not a ruling about you. The mood can turn heavy as well. Doubt about whether you are equal to the place you hold is close to standard, and ordinary tiredness starts to feel like proof of something. Very little of that survives contact with steady effort. This is how a role turns into a competence. Whatever was borrowed or premature in your visibility tends to give way, and what you actually built stays and bears weight afterward.

Jupiter's share of the Sun's chapter is usually the generous one. The decade already concerns itself with being seen; this stretch widens the room you are seen in. Offers arrive, shut doors come unstuck, and the scale of what you are doing has a way of jumping rather than creeping. The older writers put honors here, and even an ordinary life tends to bring the modern equivalents: a promotion, a platform, an invitation from somewhere larger than your usual circle. Backing is the other signature. Someone with standing may take an interest, vouch for you, or hand you a chance you have not quite earned yet. Teaching, travel, publishing, and dealings with big institutions all sit comfortably here, and so does the question of what your growing position is actually for, which Jupiter raises whether or not you asked. Growth here can be all size and no shape. Confidence runs high, and it is easy to say yes to more than you can carry, to commit while the mood is good, or to let a title inflate past the work behind it. Overreach during a Sun chapter is public when it goes wrong. The ceiling of the whole decade rises here when the growth keeps its shape. You finish the stretch operating at a larger size, with a better sense of which rooms are worth walking into.

Mars under the Sun is the sharp stretch of the chapter. Where the decade as a whole is about holding a position, this run is about contesting one. Push arrives, from you or at you. Many people use this sub to force something through: a project that needed a decision, a launch, a departure, a claim staked out loud. Effort produces results faster than it does in the slower runs, and your appetite for risk sits higher than usual. Competition sits close by. A rival becomes hard to ignore, comparisons sting, and the question of who deserves the place you are standing in can move from private worry to open contest. Anger is closer to the surface than usual. That works when it goes into the task and gets expensive when it goes into people, since the Sun's exposure means a quarrel in this stretch is generally witnessed. Watch the pace as well. This run burns fuel quickly, and the classic overshoot is a hard win followed by a flat month, or a body that finally presents the bill. Hard physical work earns its place here. Temper that gets spent on a task rarely comes back as sourness. This stretch can hand you something the gentler ones cannot. You learn that you will in fact stand up for the position you have been growing into, and having done it once in the open, you carry yourself differently afterward.
